totals.basis: verdicts measured from reviews/ files; a blind review is a control when its claim hash differs from the genuine claim in GENUINE_CONTROLS.jsonl; final verdict = after-reveal verdict when present; dollars estimated (Bartolus model times the transcript calibration factor); regression inferred

sequential_review.basis: skipped counts measured (SEQ_B.json); token saving estimated as skipped claims times the fitted marginal reviewer tokens per claim

refresh.basis: measured: REFRESH_RESULT.json verdicts, file mtimes of refresh logs and refreshed PREPARE.json; coordinator reasoning tokens are not measured; tool-code output dollars estimated as bytes/4 output tokens at Opus list price (a floor: it excludes the coordinator context re-reads)

bases.measured: read directly from a file, ledger or timestamp
bases.estimated: computed with a stated model: tokens = bytes/4; dollars = Bartolus call model at PRICES.json list rates
bases.inferred: allocated or deduced, e.g. worker tokens split evenly over a packet's assigned orders

caveats: Worker ledger "tokens" is the context size at hand-back (Claude Code subagent total), not cumulative billed tokens; cumulative prompt tokens are larger by roughly (tool_uses+1)/2.
Per-call transcripts are not visible for cloud lanes; what each producer opened is known only from its report.
Batch-check wall is taken from file mtimes and includes any pause between apply and batch-check.
False-block rates count only producer outcomes; a reviewer rejection of a submitted order would turn a "false block" into a correct one.

fixed_reading_list.basis: measured bytes; tokens estimated as bytes/4
